request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and intimate, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, piano, soft drums, hopeful and reflective mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Everyone who drinks this water
Will be thirsty again
You asked for a simple cup
From the deep and old well
But I hold a greater gift
That Jacob never knew

[Chorus]
Whoever drinks the water I give
Will never thirst again
It becomes a spring inside
Welling up to life
A fountain flowing fresh
For those who stay and hear

[Verse]
The well is deep and hard to draw
Your bucket hangs on a rope
But this water does not run out
It wells up from within
No more walking to the well
No more heavy loads

[Chorus]
Whoever drinks the water I give
Will never thirst again
It becomes a spring inside
Welling up to life
A fountain flowing fresh
For those who stay and hear

[Bridge]
Give me this water I pray
So I do not get thirsty
So I do not keep coming back
To draw what fades away

[Outro]
A spring of water
To eternal life
